text:
alex: rolling router v3.2.1 -> green cluster during approved window (23:00 UTC). plan: dry 1% (8m) -> 10% (6m) -> 40% (10m) -> gradual to 100. will exclude sensitive function-calling routes from early traffic.
priya: preflight done: redis/KV warm script ran, cold starts = 0, instances healthy. i'll tail cache-hit metric.
tom: propose thresholds: p95 > 220ms for 5m OR 5xx > 0.3% for 3m triggers regional pin. global rollback if more than 2 regions degrade.
liza: leaving `/v1/func-call` pinned to blue for first two stages. config snippet applied: `exclude_paths: ["/v1/func-call"]`
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by alex: router-service v3.2.1 -> green. Operator: @priya. Stages: 1%@8m -> 10%@6m -> 40%@10m -> 100% gradual. Auto-rollback: enabled.
ops-bot: prechecks ok: no outstanding infra alerts, zone-saturation low. dashboards: https://grafana/internal/d/routers
alex: runbook: https://runbooks.internal/router-fanout.md please follow section "regional pin" if we see localized failures.
priya: running long-context canary against green with ~900 token prompts; will post latency deltas.
tom: I'll monitor error budgets and open a short incident channel if needed.
ops-bot: Stage 1 applied: green weight=1%. logs: `deploy/1799998888/stage1` monitoring 8m.
liza: seeing slight median bump on 1 pod in ap-south, p95 still ok. :eyes:
priya: 4m into stage1: p95=165ms, 5xx=0.08% overall. long-context tail +45ms. ok to continue.
ops-bot: Stage 2 applied: green weight=10%. monitoring 6m. logs: `deploy/1799998888/stage2`
tom: 2m into stage2: ap-south 502s spiking to 0.9% (above 0.3%). isolating to region.
priya: running `kubectl logs` on green pods in ap-south; seeing upstream 502s from model-proxy timeouts. increasing proxy timeout to 8s for green in ap-south as mitigation.
alex: good catch. execute regional pin while mitigation happens.
ops-bot: Executing regional pin: `ops-bot pin region=ap-south cluster=blue reason="502 spike in ap-south during stage2"`
deploy-bot: Regional pin acknowledged. ap-south traffic pinned to blue. continuing rollout for other regions.
liza: after pin, ap-south 5xx dropped to 0.05% within 2m.
tom: leaving notes: `incident_note: ap-south model-proxy timeout regression on v3.2.1; rollback applied only regionally`.
priya: will open a follow-up ticket to roll a proxy fix: TICKET-2147.
alex: proceed to stage3 (40%) for non-pinned regions.
deploy-bot: Stage 3 applied: green weight=40% (excluding pinned regions). monitoring 10m. logs: `deploy/1799998888/stage3`
ops-bot: auto-rollback boolean remains true. to disable: `@deploy-bot set auto_rollback=false` (ops only).
liza: confirmed long-context endpoints are still served by blue and healthy.
tom: overall metrics: global p95=172ms, global 5xx=0.12%. status: nominal except pinned region.
alex: publishing this thread summary to #release-notes and closing change window at 00:30 UTC with note about ap-south pin and follow-up.
priya: creating post-deploy checklist: update runbook with proxy timeout guard and add ap-south synthetic probe.
alex: thanks team. we'll unpin ap-south after proxy fix and small smoke test.
